open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  induction post <;> simp [substOld]
  case fvar =>
    intros x Hin
    rename_i m name ty2
    simp at m
    simp at name
    simp at ty2
    simp_all
  case op =>
    intros x Hin
    rename_i m name ty2
    simp at m
    simp at name
    simp at ty2
    contradiction
  case const =>
    intros x Hin
    rename_i m name
    simp at m
    contradiction
  case bvar =>
    intros x Hin
    rename_i m d
    simp at m
    contradiction
  case abs ih =>
    exact ih
  case ite cih tih eih =>
    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
    apply List.Subset.app
    · apply List.Subset.trans cih; intros x Hin; simp_all; cases Hin <;> simp_all
    · apply List.Subset.app
      · apply List.Subset.trans tih; intros x Hin; simp_all; cases Hin <;> simp_all
      · apply List.Subset.trans eih; intros x Hin; simp_all
  case app ih1 ih2 =>
    split
    · split
      · simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *; intros x Hin; simp_all
      · simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *; intros x Hin; exact ih2 Hin
    · simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, imp_false, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
      apply List.Subset.app
      · apply List.Subset.trans ih1; intros x Hin; simp_all; cases Hin <;> simp_all
      · apply List.Subset.trans ih2; intros x Hin; simp_all
  case quant trih eih =>
    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
    apply List.Subset.app
    · apply List.Subset.trans trih; intros x Hin; rename_i m1 k1 ty1 trigger1 e1; simp_all; cases Hin <;> simp_all
    · apply List.Subset.trans eih; intros x Hin; simp_all
  case eq ih1 ih2 =>
    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
    apply List.Subset.app
    · apply List.Subset.trans ih1; intros x Hin; simp_all; cases Hin <;> simp_all
    · apply List.Subset.trans ih2; intros x Hin; simp_all
